name: Stuffed bear
description: A stuffed minion possessed by the spirit of a murdered man, incinerated in its first battle with villagers.

timeline.summary: The doll is kidnapped by bandits and sold to an evil toymaker, whose stuffed-bear minion dies in battle with villagers, leaving the doll on the street.
timeline.quote: I was kidnapped by bandits and sold to an evil toymaker.

relations.note: The toymaker had the stuffed bear as his minion.
relations.quote: He had a stuffed-bear minion who was possessed by the spirit of murdered man.

pages_say.description: A stuffed minion possessed by the spirit of a murdered man, incinerated in its first battle with villagers.
